ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which bird is represented by letter F?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a set of line drawings of bird heads, with uppercase letter labels beside each bird head. The letter F is located toward the upper left of the image, near the upper-middle position; its corresponding bird head is a small bird head in side view, with a relatively smooth and rounded crown, a relatively large and dark eye, and a beak that is relatively short and wide, forming a low triangular shape. Reasoning: The question only asks what kind of bird the letter F represents. Among the visible features of F, the short and wide, slightly flattened triangular beak and the small passerine-style head match the common broad and short bill shape and smooth rounded head features of the swallow tanager. Therefore, the letter F represents swallow tanager.
